name: Corporate Action Balance Details 42
definition: Eligible and not eligible balance of securities for a corporate action event.

TotalEligibleBalance.name: Total Eligible Balance
TotalEligibleBalance.definition: Total quantity of financial instruments of the balance.

BlockedBalance.name: Blocked Balance
BlockedBalance.definition: Balance of financial instruments that are blocked.

BorrowedBalance.name: Borrowed Balance
BorrowedBalance.definition: Balance of financial instruments that have been borrowed from another party.

CollateralInBalance.name: Collateral In Balance
CollateralInBalance.definition: Balance of securities that belong to a third party and that are held for the purpose of collateralisation.

CollateralOutBalance.name: Collateral Out Balance
CollateralOutBalance.definition: Balance of securities that belong to the safekeeping account indicated within this message, and are deposited with a third party for the purpose of collateralisation.

OnLoanBalance.name: On Loan Balance
OnLoanBalance.definition: Balance of financial instruments that have been loaned to a third party.

PendingDeliveryBalance.name: Pending Delivery Balance
PendingDeliveryBalance.definition: Balance of financial instruments that are pending delivery.

PendingReceiptBalance.name: Pending Receipt Balance
PendingReceiptBalance.definition: Balance of financial instruments that are pending receipt.

OutForRegistrationBalance.name: Out For Registration Balance
OutForRegistrationBalance.definition: Balance of financial instruments currently being processed by the institution responsible for registering the new beneficial owner (or nominee).

SettlementPositionBalance.name: Settlement Position Balance
SettlementPositionBalance.definition: Balance of securities representing only settled transactions; pending transactions not included.

StreetPositionBalance.name: Street Position Balance
StreetPositionBalance.definition: Balance of financial instruments that remain registered in the name of the prior beneficial owner.

TradeDatePositionBalance.name: Trade Date Position Balance
TradeDatePositionBalance.definition: Balance of securities based on trade date, for example, includes all pending transactions in addition to the balance of settled transactions.

InTransshipmentBalance.name: In Transshipment Balance
InTransshipmentBalance.definition: Balance of physical securities that are in the process of being transferred from one depository/agent to another.

RegisteredBalance.name: Registered Balance
RegisteredBalance.definition: Balance of financial instruments that are registered (in the name of a nominee name or of the beneficial owner).
